intervention: Local hero representation and material replacement, keeping background trees and environment fixed
observations: Reference has a short thick trunk and low irregular fork; main limbs change direction nonuniformly and taper strongly into fine branches.
Implemented low trunk, four unequal main paths, secondary/tertiary branching with branch-owned sprays and explicit tangent/radius data.
Actual main scene, isolated foliage, branch-only and bark views inspected. New bark UVs follow arc length and show plates rather than horizontal stretching.
Reference crown is more connected and luminous; current sprays still resolve as separated dark tufts. Upper twig tips are too exposed. Some junctions remain abrupt.
